title.zh: 将邦板牙省Lubao市镇Scholastica Romero区医院床位由50张增至75张并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Scholastica Romero District Hospital in the Municipality of Lubao, Province of Pampanga, From Fifty (50) to Seventy-five (75) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Scholastica Romero District Hospital in the Municipality of Lubao, Province of Pampanga, From Fifty (50) to Seventy-five (75) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tăng số giường bệnh của Bệnh viện huyện Scholastica Romero tại Thị trấn Lubao, Tỉnh Pampanga từ năm mươi lên bảy mươi lăm giường
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเพิ่มจำนวนเตียงของโรงพยาบาลอำเภอ Scholastica Romero ในเทศบาล Lubao, จังหวัด Pampanga จากห้าสิบเป็นเจ็ดสิบห้าเตียง
title.id: Undang-Undang menambah kapasitas tempat tidur dari Rumah Sakit Kabupaten Scholastica Romero di Kotamadya Lubao, Provinsi Pampanga dari lima puluh menjadi tujuh puluh lima tempat tidur
title.ms: Akta menambah kapasiti katil daripada Hospital Daerah Scholastica Romero di Perbandaran Lubao, Wilayah Pampanga daripada lima puluh kepada tujuh puluh lima katil

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7211_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The bed capacity of the Scholastica Romero District Hospital in the Municipality of Lubao, Province of Pampanga, is hereby increased from fifty (50) to seventy-five (75) beds.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
